summary: Scanned vendor batch with multiple stapled invoices ingested as single invoice, posting fails and blocks payment run
description:
Issue summary:
A PDF batch from vendor ThermaFlex Ltd. (received via AP email) contained three physical invoices stapled together. Our scanning pipeline ingested the file as a single invoice record, merged line items and totals, and created an invalid posting that failed three-way PO matching. The scheduled payrun (03/12) was blocked for this vendor as the system flagged an unresolvable mismatch and duplicate detection prevented manual splitting during the automated pre-check stage.

Impact:
- One vendor payment (ThermaFlex Ltd.) not processed in the 03/12 payrun (approx. $68,400 total across three invoices).
- AP team unable to clear the payrun because the ingestion-created invoice record fails GL allocation and PO reconciliation checks.
- Risk of late fees and vendor escalations if not resolved before next pay cycle.

Environment:
- Prod AP ingestion pipeline (ocr-batch-ingest v2.4.1)
- Scanner vendor: PaperFlow Services (scanned PDF file: TF_20260309_batch_A.pdf)
- Regions affected: us-east (primary AP region)

Steps to reproduce / observed behavior:
1) Received email with TF_20260309_batch_A.pdf attached (3 invoices stapled).
2) PDF passed to ocr-batch-ingest which runs page-level OCR then document-level consolidation.
3) Consolidation logic merged the three invoices into one invoice record because no explicit page-break anchors were found.
4) Generated invoice record had combined amounts and three different invoice numbers concatenated in the invoice_number field (e.g., "INV-1001;;;INV-1002;;;INV-1003").
5) AP system attempted PO matching and GL mapping: failed because combined totals did not equal any single PO, and 'duplicate detection' flagged the record as suspicious.
6) Payrun pre-check aborted and held the vendor group.

Error artifacts / logs:
- ocr-batch-ingest logs (ingest_id: ingest-20260309-77e2) show repeated pattern: "WARN: page_anchor_not_found, consolidating pages into single doc"
- Ingest error code: INV_PARSE_422
- OCR confidences (per page): 0.88, 0.84, 0.67 — third page contains lower confidence & partial footer obscured by staple crease.
- AP UI record ID: APINV-20260309-553 (shows combined totals and concatenated invoice_number).

Investigation notes (initial):
- Finance triage (Leah): Verified physical PDF had three distinct invoice headers when viewed in Preview. Manual split resolves PO matching.
- OCR engineer (Oscar): Confirmed consolidation module falls back to document-level grouping when page anchors absent; current heuristics miss stapled multi-invoice batches where header margin is reduced.
- SRE: No platform-wide degradation; ingestion throughput normal.

Workarounds applied / temporary resolution:
- AP team manually created three invoice records in the AP UI using the original PDF pages as attachments and matched them to the correct POs. Manual payment release processed for one invoice immediately; remaining two are queued pending final approver signatures.
- For immediate payrun unblock: OS (Oscar) applied a temporary ingest rule to force page-level split for files from "thermaflex@invoices.com" for the March 9–12 window. This bypass is logged and will be reverted after confirmation.

Proposed permanent fixes / follow-ups:
1) Engineering task: Enhance ocr-batch-ingest to detect page-boundary invoice anchors and add a page-break classifier (ML-based or heuristic) to avoid consolidating physically grouped invoices. (Create follow-up INT ticket for the eng task).
2) Update AP pre-check UI to allow ops to flag an invoice record as "split candidate" and provide an inline tool to split into N records before payrun locking.
3) Add additional OCR rules to detect repeated "Invoice Number" headers per page and prefer page-scope parsing when multiple headers exist.
4) Run a targeted backfill for ThermaFlex and other vendors with a history of multi-invoice scans for the last 30 days to ensure no missed payments.

Attachments / Links:
- Original PDF: TF_20260309_batch_A.pdf (stored in finance-shared S3: s3://redwood-finance/inbound/TF_20260309_batch_A.pdf)
- Ingest trace: https://logs.redwood.local/ingest/ingest-20260309-77e2
- AP UI record: https://ap-console.redwood.local/invoices/APINV-20260309-553
- Slack thread: #finance-ap (thread ts: 1611499328.000400)

Next actions (owners / ETA):
- Oscar Patel (OCR eng): Implement and test temporary page-split classifier (ETA: 2026-03-14).
- Leah Chen (AP): Confirm manual payments completed and update vendor contact re: remittance timing (ETA: 2026-03-12 COB).
- Eng Lead (Triage): Open engineering ticket for longer-term fix and prioritize in next sprint (sprint planning 03/15).

SLA / urgency justification:
- P1 due to direct blocking of scheduled vendor payment and potential financial penalties. Recommended targeted response within 24 hours and full remediation plan within 5 business days.
